'''Slime pods''' were creatures bloated with gas that floated in the [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. They were parts of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]' [[Diet/Legends|diet]].
